title: Audio visualizer
description: Shows animated bars that move with the music, using cava.

cava_config.label: cava settings file
cava_config.doc: Path to the cava configuration file. When provided, cava settings are read from it first.
cava_config.description: Use the settings from your own cava config file first.

framerate.label: Animation speed
framerate.doc: Target frames per second. Replaces the generic interval option.
framerate.description: How smooth the animation is. Higher looks smoother but uses more power.

autosens.label: Automatic sensitivity
autosens.doc: Automatically decrease sensitivity when the bars peak.
autosens.description: Lower the sensitivity automatically when the bars hit the top.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.doc: Manual sensitivity in %. If autosens is enabled, this is only the initial value. 200 means double height. Accepts only non-negative values.
sensitivity.description: How tall the bars get. 200 means twice as tall. With automatic sensitivity on, this is only the starting value.

lower_cutoff_freq.label: Lowest frequency
lower_cutoff_freq.doc: Lower cutoff frequency for the visualizer bandwidth.
lower_cutoff_freq.description: Lower cutoff frequency for the visualizer bandwidth.

higher_cutoff_freq.label: Highest frequency
higher_cutoff_freq.doc: Higher cutoff frequency for the visualizer bandwidth.
higher_cutoff_freq.description: Higher cutoff frequency for the visualizer bandwidth.

sleep_timer.label: Silence before hiding
sleep_timer.doc: Seconds of silence before cava enters sleep mode.
sleep_timer.description: Seconds of silence before cava enters sleep mode.

hide_on_silence.label: Hide when silent
hide_on_silence.doc: Hide the widget when silence lasts longer than sleep_timer.
hide_on_silence.description: Hide the bars when no sound plays for a while.

format_silent.label: Text when silent
format_silent.doc: Text shown when the module is silent and hide_on_silence is false. *Raw frontend only.*
format_silent.description: Shown when no sound is playing (if hiding is off).

format-icons.label: Bar characters
format-icons.doc: Array of characters used to render bar levels in the raw frontend. The number of items determines the dynamic range.
format-icons.description: The characters used to draw the bars, from the lowest to the highest.

method.label: Audio system
method.doc: Audio capture backend. Supported values: pipewire, pulse, alsa, fifo, sndio, shmem.
method.description: Where the sound is read from. On most recent systems this is PipeWire.

source.label: Audio source
source.doc: Audio source identifier. See the cava documentation for details.
source.description: Which device to listen to. "auto" picks the current output.

stereo.label: Stereo
stereo.description: Show left and right channels separately.

reverse.label: Reverse bars
reverse.doc: Reverse the bar order (highest frequencies on the left).
reverse.description: Put the high notes on the left and the low notes on the right.

bar_delimiter.label: Separator between bars
bar_delimiter.doc: Delimiter placed between bars in the raw output. Use a decimal ASCII value (e.g. 59 = ";"). 0 means no delimiter.
bar_delimiter.description: A character code placed between bars (59 is ";"). 0 means none.

data_format.label: Data format
data_format.doc: Raw data format. Can be 'binary' or 'ascii'. *Raw frontend only.*
data_format.description: Raw data format. Can be 'binary' or 'ascii'. *Raw frontend only.*

raw_target.label: Output target
raw_target.doc: Raw output target. A fifo will be created if target does not exist. *Raw frontend only.*
raw_target.description: Raw output target. A fifo will be created if target does not exist. *Raw frontend only.*

monstercat.label: Smooth bars
monstercat.description: Make neighbouring bars flow into each other, for a softer look.

waves.label: Wave effect
waves.doc: Enable the waves effect alongside Monstercat smoothing.
waves.description: Add a wave effect. Works together with "Smooth bars".

noise_reduction.label: Smoothing
noise_reduction.doc: Smoothing factor between 0.0 and 1.0. Higher values produce slower, smoother animation; lower values are more reactive but noisy.
noise_reduction.description: Higher values make the bars move slowly and smoothly, lower values make them faster but jumpier.

input_delay.label: Start delay
input_delay.doc: Delay in seconds before starting audio capture. Increase this if Waybar starts before the audio server (e.g. PipeWire).
input_delay.description: Wait before listening. Raise it if the bars stay still after login.

bar_width.label: Bar width (GPU mode)
bar_width.doc: Bar width in pixels. *Used by the GLSL frontend.*
bar_width.description: Bar width in pixels. *Used by the GLSL frontend.*

bar_spacing.label: Bar spacing (GPU mode)
bar_spacing.doc: Space between bars in pixels. *Used by the GLSL frontend.*
bar_spacing.description: Space between bars in pixels. *Used by the GLSL frontend.*

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There must be a GtkMenu element with id menu.
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: Actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

sdl_width.label: Width (GPU mode)
sdl_width.doc: GLSL frontend width in pixels. *GLSL only.*
sdl_width.description: GLSL frontend width in pixels. *GLSL only.*

sdl_height.label: Height (GPU mode)
sdl_height.doc: GLSL frontend height in pixels. *GLSL only.*
sdl_height.description: GLSL frontend height in pixels. *GLSL only.*

min-length.label: Minimum length
min-length.doc: Requested width of the GLSL widget in pixels. If not set, falls back to max-length, then sdl_width. *GLSL only.*
min-length.description: Keep the module at least this wide, so the bar doesn't jump around when the text changes.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: Fallback width of the GLSL widget if min-length is not set. *GLSL only.*
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.
